builds.title: Saffron Step, Tiger Rogue 1
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12, or 17 for scent.
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5, Intelligence save +3. Unarmored AC 10 + Dexterity 3. Expertise in Athletics and Stealth. No hands.
Keen Smell. Advantage on scent-based Perception checks.
Sneak Attack. Once per turn, add 1d6 to a Bite or Claw hit with advantage, or if an enemy of the target that is not incapacitated stands within 5 ft. of it and Saffron has no disadvantage.
actions: Bite or Claw. Melee unarmed strike +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1d8 + 3 piercing with the bite or slashing with the claw. Counts as finesse for Sneak Attack.

Pounce. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hitting it with an unarmed strike that turn, use a bonus action to try to knock it prone. Within reach, against a target no more than one size larger, contest Athletics +7 against Athletics or Acrobatics.
builds.tactics: Saffron approaches with the other scouts. In a fight, a straight approach allows Pounce, and an ally beside the target can qualify the first hit for Sneak Attack.

builds.title: Hush Thread, Weasel Rogue 2
builds.senses: Passive Perception 16, or 21 for hearing or scent.
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5, Intelligence save +3. Unarmored AC 10 + Dexterity 3. Expertise in Perception and Stealth. No hands. Tiny carrying capacity 30 lb.
Advantage on Perception checks using hearing or smell.
Sneak Attack. Once per turn, add 1d6 to a bite hit with advantage, or if an enemy of the target that is not incapacitated stands within 5 ft. of it and Hush has no disadvantage.
actions: Bite. Dexterity-based unarmed strike +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1d4 + 3 piercing. Counts as finesse for Sneak Attack.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Hush scouts by sound and scent. If surprised, Hush backs away with Disengage or breaks line of sight before using Hide.

builds.title: Rime Knell, Winter Wolf Barbarian 2
builds.senses: Passive Perception 13, or 18 for hearing or scent.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5, Constitution save +4. Natural AC is 12 + Dexterity 2. Barbarian Unarmored Defense also gives 14. No hands.
Advantage on hearing- and scent-based Perception and on Stealth used to hide in snow.
Danger Sense. Advantage on Dexterity saves against effects Rime can see while not blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.
Reckless Attack. On the first attack of the turn, choose advantage on Strength-based melee attack rolls for the turn. Attack rolls against Rime then have advantage until Rime’s next turn.
actions: Bite. Melee unarmed strike +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1d8 + 3 piercing, or 1d8 + 5 while raging.
Trip. After an unarmed hit, use a bonus action to knock the target prone if within reach and no more than one size larger. Contest Athletics +5 against Athletics or Acrobatics.
Cold Breath. Action, once per short or long rest. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. Failure takes 2d6 cold damage. Success halves it.

Rage. Bonus action, two per long rest, up to 1 minute. Advantage on Strength checks and saves, +2 Strength melee damage, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing. Ends on unconsciousness or if a turn ends without having attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since the previous turn. The breath has no attack roll and does not maintain Rage on its own. Rime can end Rage as a bonus action and cannot cast or concentrate while raging.
builds.tactics: Rime opens with breath if the cone is clear of companions. Once someone closes in, Rime bites and uses Trip on a later turn after starting Rage.

builds.title: Alder Pace, Wolf Monk 1
builds.senses: Passive Perception 14, or 19 for hearing or scent.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +3, Dexterity save +5. Monk Unarmored Defense gives AC 10 + Dexterity 3 + Wisdom 2, instead of the separate natural armor calculation of 14.
Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks using hearing or smell. Alder uses body strikes and no handheld gear.
actions: Paw strike. Melee unarmed strike +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1d4 + 3 bludgeoning using Martial Arts. After an Attack action with this strike, Alder can make one more as a bonus action.
Pack Tactics. Bonus action. Gain advantage on the next attack roll this turn against a creature within 5 ft. of Alder’s non-incapacitated ally.

Trip. After an unarmed hit, use a bonus action to knock a target within reach and no more than one size larger prone. Contest Athletics +3 against Athletics or Acrobatics. This uses the same bonus action as Pack Tactics or the extra Martial Arts strike.
builds.tactics: Alder keeps pace with slower companions. In combat, choose Pack Tactics before attacking, or save the bonus action to Trip after a hit if someone needs time to get clear.

builds.title: Gravel Jaw, Worg Monk 2
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13, or 18 for hearing or scent.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5, Dexterity save +4. Natural AC is 12 + Dexterity 2. Monk Unarmored Defense would give 13. Unarmored Movement adds 10 ft. to the 40-ft. walk. No hands.
Advantage on hearing- and scent-based Perception. Ki 2, recovered on a short or long rest that includes at least 30 minutes of meditation.
actions: Shoulder strike. Melee unarmed strike +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1d4 + 3 bludgeoning with Strength and Martial Arts. After using the Attack action for this strike, Gravel can make one more as a bonus action.
Trip. After an unarmed hit, use a bonus action to knock a target within reach and no more than one size larger prone. Contest Athletics +5 against Athletics or Acrobatics.
Flurry of Blows. Immediately after the Attack action, spend 1 ki for two bonus-action unarmed strikes at +5 to hit, 1d4 + 3 bludgeoning each.
Patient Defense. Spend 1 ki to Dodge as a bonus action. Step of the Wind. Spend 1 ki to Dash or Disengage as a bonus action, and double jump distance for the turn.
builds.tactics: Gravel offers one warning in Goblin. If the warning fails, Gravel uses Trip to hold a chokepoint or spends ki to Disengage and block the next exit.

concepts.name: Saffron Step
concepts.motive: Find the lost surveyors before the sluice opens.
concepts.hook: Saffron circles a fresh boot print in the mud and tells the party exactly how long the scent has been there.

concepts.name: Hush Thread
concepts.motive: Find which house is dumping warm ash into the drain.
concepts.hook: A trail of ash ends at a grate Hush can slip past. The party can help trace the supply cart above ground.

concepts.name: Rime Knell
concepts.motive: Learn why a second bell answers from an abandoned mountain path.
concepts.hook: Rime will guide the party to shelter in exchange for an extra pair of ears on the night watch.

concepts.name: Alder Pace
concepts.motive: Find a safe place to shift the marked trail away from a fresh rockslide.
concepts.hook: Alder leads travelers to a split in the cairns and asks the party to inspect the higher switchback.

concepts.name: Gravel Jaw
concepts.motive: Collect the overdue fee for escorting a mule train through the quarry.
concepts.hook: Gravel knows the drivers took a different road and offers to split the fee with anyone who can find their trail.
